motivation: Audit confirms the live frozen high_sensitivity profile uses k=4. The earlier transparent stage probe and exact-center kernel experiment intentionally prescribed k=3; their results are valid for those samples but not an exact parameter match to the live pipeline. Do not revise their historical plans or infer a live-pipeline speedup from them.
source: Import the untouched original live source root from full_search_hillclimb_r1_v3_20261012/execution_plan.json; retain original compiled CPU libraries and default scoring route. No package rebuild or running source mutation.
sample: Same three filename-hash-selected QfO species, 32 gene-ID-hash-selected queries in original order per cyclic species pair, and complete target proteomes as the earlier label-free stage probe.
design: For each of six cases, run the original native search once uninstrumented and once with transparent function timing wrappers. Require identical query/target index, score, E-value and candidate-count fingerprints. Record actual call parameters, input/source/runtime pins and post-exec RSS.
selection: Use sampled stage costs only to prioritize later computational experiments. Do not interpret instrumented versus uninstrumented wall differences as an optimization contrast, extrapolate full-pipeline speed, or infer orthology accuracy from hit counts. A k4 sample cannot validate the rejected k3 recurrence experiment as a general speed improvement.
limitations: Small development-exposed sample on a shared host; neither independent biological confirmation nor a full-dataset profile.
